name: HelpWave AI
author: HelpWave

sections.description:
HelpWave AI is an AI-powered chatbot plugin designed to act as a virtual store assistant. It engages website visitors in personalized conversations, showcases your products, and provides instant answers to their questions.

Key Features:

  • Showcase Your Products: Drive sales through personalized and engaging conversations.
  • Instant Support: Use site FAQs and information to provide immediate responses.
  • Detailed Insights: Track visitor interactions with comprehensive analytics.
  • Multilingual Support: Available in English and French.

Benefits:

  • Provide product recommendations to customers.
  • Highlight your brand’s strengths.
  • Enhance user experience and increase conversions.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 (or later). See https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html for details.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin’s ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Click Upload Plugin, select the ZIP file, and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  5. Navigate to the HelpWave section in the left-hand menu.
  6. Log in or create an account.
  7. Customize your chatbot under Settings > Chats.
sections.faq:
How do I set up HelpWave AI?

Follow the installation steps to activate and configure HelpWave AI for your site.

Does the plugin support multiple languages?

Yes, HelpWave AI supports English and French.

Can I add custom FAQ responses?

Yes, you can add or edit responses through the chatbot’s settings.
